title: Auto Sorting Machine
description: Automatically sorts items into nearby containers.
body:
# Auto Sorting Machine

Automatically sorts items into nearby containers.

Auto Sorting Machine is a lightweight Fabric mod that automatically transfers and sorts items into nearby containers, helping keep storage systems organized without complicated setups.

## Features

* Automatic item sorting
* Nearby container detection
* Chest, Barrel and Hopper support
* Survival-friendly design
* Multiplayer compatible
* Lightweight and server-friendly
* Fabric 1.21.11 support

## Default Settings

* Sorting range: 16 blocks
* Transfer speed: Hopper-equivalent
* Maximum transfer amount: 16 items per operation
* Prioritizes containers with matching items

## Supported Containers

* Chest
* Trapped Chest
* Barrel
* Hopper

## Compatibility

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API

## Future Development

Auto Sorting Machine is the foundation of future storage and logistics systems within the Maikura series.
